title: Kawasaki Heavy aims for fully autonomous humanoid AI robot by 2030
key_facts: Kawasaki Heavy Industries plans to release a fully autonomous, AI-powered humanoid robot as soon as 2030.
The robot is the Kaleido humanoid, which Kawasaki has been developing since 2015.
It will run on a 'physical AI' platform being developed in Japan by a company called Noetra.
Only the headline, subhead and opening paragraph were readable; the rest is behind the Nikkei paywall.
quote_evidence: Kawasaki Heavy Industries plans to release a fully autonomous humanoid robot powered by artificial intelligence as soon as 2030, which will be made possible with a physical AI platform being developed in Japan.
Kaleido android to incorporate homegrown platform under development by Noetra
why_it_matters_hint: A major Japanese industrial group sets a date for a self-directed humanoid, using a domestic AI platform rather than a US or Chinese one.
notes: Paywall: only the lede was readable. No other outlet found carrying the story. Noetra is described only as a Japanese developer of the platform.
